subject: art-design

items.q: Does a good photo just need an expensive camera?
items.correct: No — composition, light and intent matter more than the gear.
items.misconception: Yes, the camera does all the work.
items.why: Strong images come from seeing and composing.

items.correct: No — editing has always been part of photography.
items.why: Selecting and adjusting images is part of the creative process.

items.q: Does composition (e.g. rule of thirds) matter?
items.correct: Yes — it guides the viewer's eye and strengthens an image.
items.why: Composition is a key creative decision.

specSource: Cambridge IGCSE Art & Design (0400) syllabus; Photography and Digital Media
